function.name: _perform_text_block_as_special_command
function.return: last special-command line result; 1 is immediate stop/handled

semantics: Acquire or allocate one reusable 0x7E8-byte record buffer.
Fetch candidate records in ascending fetch index, bounded to 50 attempts.
Stop when a fetched record identifier differs from the requested textblock ID.
Split payload at LF in-place, execute each line, then restore/advance the delimiter.
Return immediately when the line executor returns 1.
Always return the record buffer to the local reuse pool before returning.

ownership.recordFetch: MajorMUD local wrapper over Worldgroup database APIs
ownership.hostCallbacks: No direct imported Worldgroup callback is called by the wrapper itself; host services are reached beneath local helpers.
